test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true according to the passage?

options.text: Darwin suffered from a number of problems like vomiting, fatigue, cramps, anxiety, etc.
Newton’s period of isolation was his year of wonder as he was intellectually transformed during this time.
Milton was furious at the prospect of spending 40 days in lockdown, a measure he considered absolutely unnecessary.
Newton and Byron were the alumni of Trinity College, of the Cambridge University.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Milton was furious at the prospect of spending 40 days in lockdown, a measure he considered absolutely unnecessary.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**When we read the given passage, we get to know many facts about many renowned people.

Such as "Isaac Newton", "Charles Darwin", "Lord Byron", and "John Milton".

 
• ***There is no doubt in saying that Darwin’s experience with isolation was not the result of a pandemic but his own chronic ill health. He suffered from a myriad of unexplained symptoms, including vertigo, vomiting, cramps, fatigue, anxiety and visual disturbances. ***
 
• ***It's completely true that Newton was so intellectually transformed by his period of isolation that later commentators have referred to his time away from Cambridge as his annus mirabilis, or his ‘year of wonders’.”***
 
• ***__But it was Lord Byron __who was furious at the prospect of spending 40 days in lockdown, a measure he considered absolutely unnecessary, **__not John Milton.__*
 
• ***We get to know that Newton and Byron were the alumni of Trinity College, of the Cambridge University.​​***

​So, it's clear from the above-mentioned detail, that statement 3 must be corrected.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

85:T
